notes:
Top-line: enterprise research portal for sell-side and PM research. Primary goal is a searchable research index with high-quality reranking for short-listing research notes and analyst models. Preference for Redwood Dedicated + VPC + KMS/HSM.

Scale targets: index 30-50M documents (firm research reports, models, time-series attachments) representing ~1.2-2.5B tokens. Query profile: daytime business hours heavy (avg 20 QPS, peak 120 QPS for internal research desk bursts). Target SLO: interactive search p95 < 300ms (embedding ANN fetch + lightweight rerank), full rerank p95 < 800ms acceptable for deep queries.

Cost sensitivity: procurement is focused on predictable unit economics - target blended cost per query <= $0.02 for common search (embed+ANN), rerank stage budgeted separately. Want Redwood Optimize recommendations on batching, quantization and cache TTLs to hit cost targets.

Security/compliance: must support EU data residency for EU desk, AWS KMS integration (customer-managed keys), SOC2/ISO27001 required, detailed audit logs & retention controls. Legal flagged cross-border model telemetry and logging policies.

Technical notes / preferences: two-stage retrieval architecture — off-the-shelf 1536-d dense embeddings for indexing + a smaller transformer reranker for candidate ordering. Interested in Redwood's embedding catalog + a verified reranker variant tuned for finance. Need ability to pin model version and automatic fallback when dedicated pool is saturated.

Quotes / call snippets: "We need predictable per-query pricing — spikes are OK if the baseline cost is controlled." — Head of Research IT. "If you can show a dedicated pool with EU residency and KMS, we can accelerate." — Procurement lead.

POC ask: 1) 72-hour dedicated pool trial with a 500k-doc sample, measure index build time, embedding cost, ANN latency, and reranker p95; 2) KMS key wrap test and audit log sample; 3) draft SOW for 12-month committed capacity.

CRM shorthand: multiple stakeholders (Research ops, SecOps, Procurement, Legal). SE to run architecture workshop week of 2026-03-08.
